from pathlib import Path
import pydantic

import warnings,math
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from pydantic.types import ImportString

    from pydantic import PyObject as PublicAlias

assert TypeAdapter(PublicAlias).validate_python("math.cos") is math.cos
